searchResults.title: Unilab Board of Directors, Pioneers, & Leaders | Unilab
searchResults.highlight:
My father, Jose Y. Campos, and his partner, Mariano K. Tan, went on to put up United Drug, a corner drugstore in the heart of Binondo. They built the company to provide quality and affordable medicines at a time of widespread healthcare scarcity. Day after day, they religiously lived out the values of husay at malasakit – going to great lengths beyond was typically required of them – to answer every call, and tend to every customer as best they could. And they did this together.
...
From our beginnings 80 years ago, the once corner drugstore has metamorphosed to what we now call Unilab, the leading pharmaceutical company in the country. But our story doesn’t end here. Responding to the evolving needs of our customers, we have been expanding our business into different aspects of healthcare, thus further transforming ourselves into a more wide-ranging, integrated health products-and-services enterprise.
...
We see a future where more people are given the chance to live lives of holistic quality and good health. This vision beckons us to action and guides us to its realization. In recent years, the company has therefore taken deliberate steps to provide more than just medicines to its customers.
...
Today, Unilab is part of a larger enterprise, that is Unilab Group, which brings to our customers greater access to prescription medicines, over-the-counter medicines, branded generics, wellness & natural products, personal care solutions, health services, and even animal healthcare. We view all these as interrelated and integrated offerings to address the evolving healthcare needs of the Filipino people as the Philippine economy grows.
